The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a robust DBA (dynamic Bayesian averaging) may outperform a simple mean.
test a robust median combination, exploiting the trend‑dominated, high‑predictability series and unstable rankings.
Test a robust weighted combination with softmax‑negative‑error weights to see if a non‑linear weighting improves over inverse_error and mean, given the trend‑dominated, unstable ranking series.
The series is trend-dominated with high predictability and unstable rankings; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
test a weighted combination on the stable top‑7 pool using inverse_error weights to see if a more focused weighting improves over the robust DBA.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a robust DBA on a reduced correlated pool (pool4) may improve over full pool DBA.
test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the smaller, more diverse pool4 to see if per‑horizon averaging improves on the robust DBA baseline.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings, so a robust per‑horizon weighting that picks the best model at each step may capture changing strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9904. Series context: trend strength 0.9595 and seasonal strength 0.4048; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.099); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.427.
